svg.title: Where a correction lands
svg.desc: A chalkboard diagram inside the outline of the Orange Tomato mascot head. A versioned shelf (base specs plus a 2026-10-05 retest of 19 hours versus 24 hours and a 2026-10-12 erratum correcting 410 grams to 365 grams) feeds three outcomes around the central change: a RAG re-read that shows both figures with dates, a wiki without update that repeats 24 hours and 410 grams, and a wiki after update that matches after about 15 and 5 minutes. A traceability card notes stale citations stop at September 22 while fresh citations carry new dates. Limits: synthetic corpus, single trials, no self-updating wiki.
